headline: Uganda enters global oil market - CAJ News Africa
summary: Uganda has named its crude oil blend Pearl Sweet as it moves toward first commercial oil production and exports by the end of 2026, nearly two decades after discovery in the Albertine Graben.
why: First commercial exports would make Uganda a new crude supplier, with implications for East African energy revenues and regional oil infrastructure.
